jobs.title: Associate Director, Strategic Operations
jobs.why: Excellent behavioral-health operations fit centered on workflow redesign, cross-functional program leadership, KPI rigor, automation, operational efficiency, and scaling care delivery. Strong overlap with healthcare operations, training, intake/workflow systems, and process improvement.
jobs.gap: The role prefers 4–6 years in consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, or strategic operations and strong financial fluency. Emphasize hands-on operational transformation, measurable process improvements, automation, reporting, and cross-functional ownership.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Transformation
jobs.location: United States · Remote · Travel to Boston
jobs.why: Strong healthcare implementation and operations role leading complex health-system programs, clinical workflows, operational readiness, stakeholder coordination, process optimization, and AI-enabled transformation.
jobs.gap: Specialty pharmacy, EMR, 340B, and medication-access experience are domain gaps. Position healthcare operations, implementation, documentation, workflow design, systems, and stakeholder management as the transferable core.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Very strong digital-health implementation match: end-to-end launches, requirements gathering, cross-functional coordination, client communication, risk management, and scalable playbooks all map closely to operations and systems-project experience.
jobs.gap: The posting prefers 5+ years of implementation/client onboarding/program management and digital-health or benefits experience. Emphasize healthcare operations, onboarding/training, requirements translation, workflow implementation, and multi-stakeholder project ownership.

jobs.title: Client Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare implementation role with direct overlap in onboarding, project plans, client communication, cross-functional coordination, risk tracking, and operational handoff. The healthcare navigation/PBM setting also aligns with payer-facing workflow experience.
jobs.gap: Direct PBM/navigation implementation experience is preferred. Emphasize insurance workflows, documentation, intake, healthcare operations, process ownership, and experience coordinating multiple stakeholders.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong mental-health-tech business operations opportunity focused on scaling operations, solving cross-functional problems, building processes, and improving how the organization executes. The healthcare setting makes the systems and operations background especially relevant.
jobs.gap: Headway may favor candidates with deeper strategy, analytics, or high-growth startup experience. Lead with operational systems, CRM/workflow automation, business analysis, implementation, and healthcare domain knowledge.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent behavioral-health operations domain fit with provider quality, scalable programs, clinical workflow improvement, AI-powered documentation, and cross-functional execution.
jobs.gap: The role explicitly expects highly proficient SQL and advanced analytical modeling. Keep SQL positioned as foundational/working knowledge and emphasize Excel/reporting, operational analysis, clinical workflows, process improvement, and execution strength.

jobs.title: Marketing & Communications Program Manager
jobs.why: Strong crossover between healthcare, program management, and growth operations. The job owns intake systems, prioritization, Asana workflows, dashboards, status reporting, SOPs, cross-functional coordination, and technology transformation.
jobs.gap: The function sits within marketing/communications rather than core healthcare operations. Emphasize prior marketing experience plus workflow systems, project management, reporting, automation, and cross-functional operating cadence rather than SEO.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: High-upside generalist operations role involving new-market launches, pilots, cross-functional initiatives, process creation, and direct work with leadership. Strong match for a systems-minded operator who can build structure in ambiguity.
jobs.gap: The role likely expects stronger financial modeling and strategy experience than the current background shows. Emphasize business analysis, operational problem solving, reporting, workflow design, stakeholder management, and fast learning.

jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong remote business-operations role focused on operating strategy, cross-functional execution, scalable processes, and decision support. Good alignment with process improvement, systems work, reporting, and program execution.
jobs.gap: The senior level may require more depth in strategic planning and quantitative analysis. Emphasize multi-function project ownership, process design, automation, reporting, and measurable operational outcomes.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Good systems-and-operations match at a growth-stage software company, with hands-on process building, cross-functional work, and GTM operations in an environment that values both execution and big-picture thinking.
jobs.gap: Equipment-rental/construction software is outside the target industries, and the role may expect deeper startup strategy/GTM exposure. Emphasize CRM, workflow automation, process improvement, reporting, implementation, and cross-functional execution.
